# Kingfisher

> Kingfisher is an open source secret scanner and credential-response tool. It
> detects exposed credentials, validates which are active, maps blast radius, supports visual
> triage, and revokes supported secrets.

Kingfisher is written in Rust and licensed under Apache-2.0. Use TOON output for LLM and agent
workflows: `kingfisher scan <target> --format toon --no-update-check`.
